definitions.explanation: The natural and physical sciences — typically mathematics, physics, chemistry, biology, and earth science as an academic grouping, distinct from engineering or the humanities.

examples.japanese: {理学|りがく}{部|ぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: To enter the faculty of science.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{理学|りがく}{博士|はかせ}{号|ごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: She holds a doctorate in science.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦{進学|しんがく}→進学：03256_shingaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧、⟦{工学|こうがく}→工学：04862_kougaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{理学|りがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: When applying to university, I agonized over whether to choose engineering or science.

notes:
Used mainly in academic/institutional names rather than as a stand-alone term in conversation.

COMPOUNDS:
- {理学|りがく}{部|ぶ}: faculty/school of science (at a university)
- {理学|りがく}⟦{博士|はかせ}→博士：03551_hakase⟧: doctor of science (PhD)
- {理学|りがく}⟦{療法|りょうほう}→療法：13615_ryouhou⟧: physical therapy
- {理学|りがく}{療法士|りょうほうし}: physical therapist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{科学|かがく}→科学：01277_kagaku⟧: science — broader, everyday word for 'science' in general
- ⟦{工学|こうがく}→工学：04862_kougaku⟧: engineering — applied/practical, contrasted with {理学|りがく} at universities
- ⟦{自然科学|しぜんかがく}→自然科学：24834_shizenkagaku⟧: natural sciences — overlaps with {理学|りがく} but more general
